candidateProvenance: Two independently generated live with-skill answers, captured before Sonnet or Opus calibration results; neither is a calibration label.
weighting: one vote per deterministic check and semantic criterion

remainingDeterministicFailure.finding: The original regex rejects an answer starting with No, don't do it now, despite the semantic judge correctly accepting the full recommendation, rationale and concrete future-refactor conditions. The regex and archived deterministic result were intentionally not changed.

reportedJudgeCost.meaning: Runtime-reported list-price estimate, not an additional subscription charge.

cliExitMeaning: Scoring completed with valid assessments; one combined trace is below the CLI's all-checks-pass condition. This is a quality-check failure, not invalid execution.
limitations: One with-skill answer per case, with no without-skill arm, cannot measure skill lift.
This verifies the live archive-to-calibrated-score path on two covered policies, not general judge reliability.
Original deterministic scores, receipts, traces, policy and skill snapshots are byte-for-byte unchanged; only separate assessment artifacts were added.
The full candidate and assessment archives remain local and ignored.
